pr_title: Fix protocol error caused by redis-benchmark
pr_body:
The protocol error was caused by the buggy `writeHandler` in `redis-benchmark.c`,
which didn't handle one of the cases, thereby repeating data, leading to protocol errors
when the values being sent are very long.

This PR fixes #10233, issue introduced by #7959

issue_context.title: [BUG] Protocol error in redis-benchmark
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**

A protocol error happens when running `redis-benchmark`.

**To reproduce**

Run the redis server with the default configuration and verbose logging.
Run `redis-benchmark -P 1 -t set -n 1 -c 1 -d 50000000`

**Expected behavior**

The benchmark should finish without errors.

**Additional information**

I'm using Ubuntu 20.04 LTS in a VM. I built redis from the 6.2.6 branch with SSL/TLS.
